test_case.description: POS - Update Care Team with one or more participants
test_case.setup: Refer the Module (GID-2465912) containing the Pre-Requisite steps. 1. Add role1..role4 and retrieve role codes. 2-5. Create Practitioner P1/P2 and PractitionerRole PR1/PR2 as participant members. 6. Create a CareTeam Resource with only required content (no Participant) and note the ID.
test_case.steps: Step 1. Update CareTeam adding Participant PTP1 (Practitioner P1, Role1, period). Step 2. Add PTP2 (PractitionerRole PR1, Role2). Step 3. Add PTP3 (Practitioner P2, Role2). Step 4. Add PTP4 (PractitionerRole PR2, Role1). Step 5. Update PTP1 to Role3/Period3. Step 6. Update PTP1 and PTP3 to Role4/Period4.
test_case.expectedResults: ExpectedResult 1-4. Update success=true; resource contains PTP1..PTP4 cumulatively. ExpectedResult 5. Only four participants remain; PTP1 role/period replaced with Role3/Period3; others unchanged. ExpectedResult 6. PTP1 and PTP3 updated to Role4/Period4; PTP2/PTP4 unchanged.

requirements.text: The Directory service shall support managing care team participant. Optional. One or more participants per care team. Support Practitioner and PractitionerRole references, optional role(s), and a UTC ISO-8601 start/end period. Support adding/deleting participants to a new or existing care team. Directory does NOT validate the existence of an associated resource during creation and update.

The Directory service shall provide the ability to update an existing care team resource's attributes regardless of status or creator. Updated resource contains the information provided. Update requests adhere to resource requirements (required fields, supported list values).

requirement.text: The Directory service shall support managing care team participant.

decomposed_specifications.description: The service shall update an existing care team resource's attributes.
decomposed_specifications.acceptance_criteria: Given an existing resource and a valid update, the resource's attributes are updated.

test_case.comments: The test covers participant add/update flows and reference-type handling but does not exercise deletion or the no-existence-validation clause.
clarification_questions: Is Module GID-2465912 sufficient to reproduce all prerequisite data including role codes and resource IDs?
Should this test also verify deletion and non-existence validation for PRJ01713-PRQ-834, or are those intentionally out of scope?
